text: Rhea: Quick a11y pass on the Models table in the Insights view — sortable column headers behave oddly for keyboard + screen reader users. Notes below. a11y-bot: Automated scan: 5 missing aria-sort attributes, 2 keyboard focus order issues (headers not reachable with Arrow nav), 3 contrast warnings for chevron icons on dark theme. Tom: Can you paste repro steps? I couldn't repro in ChromeVox earlier. Rhea: Steps (VoiceOver + Safari): 1) Open Insights > Models table 2) Tab to header row, try to focus the 'Name' header and press Space/Enter to sort Expected: header is reachable, announced as "Name, column header, sortable, not sorted" and pressing Space toggles sort and announces new direction. Actual: header receives focus as plain text cell, VO reads only "Name", pressing Space does nothing. DOM snippet:```html Name ▾ ``` Priya: Looks like headers aren't interactive elements. We should make each header a button (or role=button) inside th and manage aria-sort on the th. Pattern: `th[role=columnheader] button[aria-label="Sort by Name"]` and update `th`'s `aria-sort` value to "ascending|descending|none". Also include visually-hidden text like "sorted ascending" when active. Luca: Keyboard semantics: we should support both Enter and Space to activate sort, and allow left/right arrow to move header focus (roving tabindex pattern). Ensure focus remains on the header button after sort so screen readers announce the change. Avoid shifting focus to table body. Tom: For announcements, I'd add a small aria-live="polite" region that receives concise updates, e.g., "Sorted by Name, ascending". But be careful not to duplicate the native aria-sort announcement. Maybe prefer aria-sort on th and only use aria-live when aria-sort announcements are inconsistent across SRs. Rhea: Also saw double announcements on VoiceOver: it said "Name column header, sorted ascending" then our aria-live said "Sorted by Name, ascending". Suggest we remove the aria-live and rely on aria-sort first; if a SR doesn't announce aria-sort reliably, then add aria-live as a fallback gated by user-agent detection (avoid duplicates). Priya: Visual: chevron color in dark theme fails contrast at small sizes. Propose using token `--muted-700` for chevrons in dark theme or increase size to 14px + ensure 3:1 contrast for focus ring. Luca: Implementation notes: - Wrap label in a button: `` - Update aria-sort on interaction, toggle icons with `aria-hidden` and provide sr-only status text only when aria-sort doesn't work. - Roving tabindex for header buttons: only one tabindex=0 at a time; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus. - Handle Space/Enter activation and preventDefault for Space to avoid scrolling. a11y-bot: Checklist for PR: - Add button elements inside th with proper aria-labels - Update th[aria-sort] on change and include sr-only fallback text where needed - Implement roving tabindex for header buttons and Arrow key handlers - Ensure Space/Enter toggles sort and prevent page scroll on Space - Swap chevron color tokens to meet contrast in dark/light themes - Add axe + VoiceOver e2e assertions: header announcement, sort direction, no duplicate live announcements Tom: I'll file a tiny PR that does the DOM changes + token update and include a short VoiceOver test script and before/after screenshots. Assigning to @Priya for review. :thumbsup:
